what.text: A desktop app that is a live view of your runs: no backend, no service account, no database client and no credential of its own.

released.text: The console ships for macOS only: one universal disk image and one archive, signed and notarised by Apple. Install the CLI first, because the CLI is the data plane. Windows and Linux builds do not exist yet.

not_released.text: Not released yet. The console is built for macOS and has not been published: this section carries no download link until its own release exists.

properties.title: Strictly read-only
properties.text: Everything the console runs is read-only; kill, resume and cancel stay in the CLI.

properties.title: No telemetry
properties.text: No telemetry, no crash reporting, no analytics, and an update check that carries no identifier.

properties.title: Its own artifact
properties.text: Its own release, published from the CLI's tag, declaring the CLI versions it was built against.
